reason: A Windows Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness that adds standalone window and system-tray access, region screenshot questioning, session management, and local dsh service setup.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面壳，支持独立窗口、系统托盘、区域截图提问、会话管理和本地服务启动。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness with a standalone window, system tray, region screenshot questions, session management, and local service startup.

capabilities: Provides a Windows Electron desktop interface for DeepSeek Harness
Captures selected screen regions and places screenshots into the chat input
Runs or reuses a local dsh web service and manages its child process
Maintains system-tray presence and local session management
Writes captured screenshots and application logs to local storage
